commit.message:
[skills] eas-app-stores: scope signing and submission to verified releases (#224)

Build and submit the requested app using verified build IDs and
destinations. Keep account-owner credential setup private, and summarize
selected build/submission fields instead of displaying raw status
output. Include validated failure codes and canonical Expo documentation
links when available; keep free-text errors and private URLs hidden.
Correct the Android submission profile example.

A test ZIP based on an earlier head of this PR, packaged as `expo2`
version 1.15.4 with npm CLI references pinned, passed the ChatGPT plugin
submission scan on November 17, 2026 (author-reported). The repository
manifests remain at 1.15.5; the source skill commands still use
`@latest`.

## Test plan

- `bun test scripts` — 42 passed on this top branch, including 22
release status summary tests.
- `bun scripts/check-skill-limits.ts`, `bun
scripts/check-overview-routing.ts`, and `bun
scripts/check-plugin-version-bump.ts origin/main` — passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed.
- GitHub `check` workflow must complete successfully on this head
commit.

---------

Co-authored-by: Kudo Chien <kudo@KudodeMacBook-Pro.local>
